name: inboxeu-business
description: Administer Inbox.eu Business Premium domains and mailboxes through the local MCP server.

interface.longDescription: List domains, mailboxes and their IDs, find accounts by address, check administrators, and list invoices with 11 read-only tools. Full mode exposes all 25 tools, including mailbox creation, updates, deletion, and administrator invitations.
defaultPrompt: Call inboxeu_check_auth to verify my Inbox.eu Business connection.
List my domain's mailboxes and their internal IDs.
